::: {#def-nuisance-hyperparameter}

#### Nuisance hyperparameter

A **nuisance hyperparameter** of an experiment is a [hyperparameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/model-selection.html#sec-hyperparameters) that the experiment tunes for each value of its [scientific hyperparameters](#def-scientific-hyperparameter),
so that those values are compared fairly [@godbole2023playbook].
The name follows statistics,
where a nuisance [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) is one that a model needs but the analysis is not about.

:::
